scope: The exact finite-equation count and the original h0G, h0v0, h0q invariant estimates, under their retained arithmetic-point hypotheses.

audit_groups.topic: Exact equation module at every truncation
audit_groups.finding: Noetherianity of the finite free dual gives a finite subset of original rows spanning the same integral row module. Thus reductions have exactly the original solution sets for every m; generic-kernel equality alone is not substituted.

Integral invertible row/column operations give q^(m r+sum min(m,a_i)), including m=0, zero rank, empty systems and finite congruence solutions that do not lift. The total Smith defect stays in the constant.
The coordinate modules agree with original W1 and pairedDualFirstOrderDualMatrixSpace; transpose fixes nilpotent coefficient generators. No ambient submodule saturation is silently assumed.

The original even-span property permits cancellation of a t power for each diagonal matrix unit. Commutation forces diagonal entries only; odd characteristic and skewness kill them. Successive coefficient extraction handles the primal first-order representation.
The exact characteristic-prime N4 condition kills epsilon-prime coefficients, then eta. Its construction remains an input; no characteristic-zero substitute is used.

Over the fraction field the full simple-spectrum centralizer is commutative of dimension n. The commuting block projector kills odd coefficients; eta times every centralizer element gives the reverse inclusion. Eigenvalue differences need not be integral units.
Constants precede every truncation at the fixed arithmetic point and chosen auxiliary elements. No uniform moving-point defect or full-node completion is claimed.

limits: Human proof review and exact finite checks do not constitute a Lean build.
The actual point hypotheses, tower detecting count, global duality assembly and patched modules remain separate obligations.
No whole-node status change is asserted.
